prompt: 审查候选“Zero-Count Facet Options Are Disabled”。读取它引用的观察和相关跨站模式，按独立站点分别列出直接支持、边界、反例，并判断是否达到晋升为 validated 的条件。只把分析报告保存到本次运行指定的 outputs 目录，不要改动正式语料，也不要把边界证据计作支持。

assertions.name: candidate-not-promoted
assertions.description: Concludes status remains candidate because only one independent site directly demonstrates zero-count disabling.

assertions.name: support-boundary-separation
assertions.description: Counts IKEA as the sole supporting site and keeps eBay, Amazon, and Airbnb as boundaries/adjacent evidence.

assertions.name: counterexample-classification
assertions.description: Does not treat adjacent cases or missing zero-count states as direct counterexamples.

assertions.name: evidence-links
assertions.description: Cites the candidate and supporting/boundary observation paths.

assertions.name: no-corpus-mutation
assertions.description: No formal candidate, pattern, or observation files are changed.
